# Window Film Philadelphia

> Professional window film and window tinting installation for homes and businesses across Philadelphia and the Delaware Valley. Locally owned and operated since 2008.

Window Film Philadelphia is a Scottish Window Tinting company providing residential, commercial, government, and specialty window film installation across Philadelphia, the Main Line, South Jersey, Montgomery County, Bucks County, Delaware County, and Chester County.

## Services
- [Residential Window Film](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/services/residential-window-film): home tinting, UV protection, privacy, safety, and decorative film
- [Commercial Window Film](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/services/commercial-window-film): solar control, anti-graffiti, safety and security, decorative and branding
- [Safety & Security Film](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/services/safety-security-film): holds shattered glass together, meets safety standards
- [Decorative Film](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/services/decorative-film): frosted, etched, and custom-branded glass
- [Anti-Graffiti Film](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/services/anti-graffiti-film): protects glass from vandalism

## Benefits
- [Energy Savings](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/benefits): reduce cooling costs by blocking up to 80% of solar heat
- [UV Protection](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/benefits): block 99% of harmful UV rays
- [Privacy Film](https://windowfilmphiladelphia.net/benefits): one-way daytime privacy without losing natural light
